raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

  Since #37874, `MooncakeTransferEngine.initialize` calls `TransferEngine.initialize` through `run_with_deadline`, which runs it on a new thread. A new thread starts on device 0, so every rank initializes Mooncake against GPU 0 instead of its own `gpu_id`, and ranks on other GPUs open an extra context on GPU 0.

  This has the same root cause as #38774 (NIXL backend init) and #45678 (Mooncake transfer worker threads). Neither of those covered the transfer engine init path.

  Related: #40056 and #44389 report that Ascend TE init fails for the same reason. This change also binds the NPU device in the init thread, which should cover their TE init failure. It does not cover the `mooncake_store` part of #40056.

  ## Modifications

  - `python/sglang/srt/distributed/device_communicators/mooncake_transfer_engine.py`: the function passed to `run_with_deadline` calls `bind_thread_to_device(self.gpu_id)` (added in #45678) before `self.engine.initialize(...)`. The init deadline is unchanged. The helper goes through `current_platform.set_device`, so it works on CUDA, NPU and XPU,
  and does nothing on platforms that do not support setting a device. It is imported inside the function, so `distributed/` does not import `disaggregation/` at module load.
  - `test/registered/unit/distributed/test_mooncake_transfer_engine_device.py`: a CPU-only regression test that uses a fake platform and the real `run_with_deadline` thread. It checks that `set_device("cuda:3")` and then `initialize` both run on the init thread, not on the caller thread. Without the fix, only `initialize` is recorded.

  ## Accuracy Tests

  Not applicable: no change to model outputs.

  ## Speed Tests and Profiling

  Not applicable: this adds one `set_device` call during transfer engine initialization.

  ## Checklist

  - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
  - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
  - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (N/A)
  - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A)
  - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

  ## Review and Merge Process

  1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
  2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
  3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
     - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
  4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -208,13 +208,20 @@ def initialize(
             # Default is "rdma"; set MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL=efa on AWS EFA hardware.
             protocol = envs.MOONCAKE_PROTOCOL.get()
 
-        ret_value = run_with_deadline(
-            lambda: self.engine.initialize(
+        def _initialize() -> int:
+            from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.utils import bind_thread_to_device
+
+            # run_with_deadline runs this on a new thread, which defaults to device 0.
+            bind_thread_to_device(self.gpu_id)
+            return self.engine.initialize(
                 hostname,
                 "P2PHANDSHAKE",
                 protocol,
                 device_name if device_name is not None else "",
-            ),
+            )
+
+        ret_value = run_with_deadline(
+            _initialize,
             timeout_s=envs.SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_ENGINE_INIT_TIMEOUT.get(),
             what=f"Mooncake TransferEngine.initialize({hostname!r}, {protocol!r}, {device_name!r})",
         )

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import threading
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock, patch
+
+from sglang.srt import platforms
+from sglang.srt.distributed.device_communicators.mooncake_transfer_engine import (
+    MooncakeTransferEngine,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestMooncakeTransferEngineDevice(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_initialize_selects_device_in_deadline_thread(self):
+        calls = []
+        platform = MagicMock()
+        platform.get_device.side_effect = lambda gpu_id: f"cuda:{gpu_id}"
+        platform.set_device.side_effect = lambda device: calls.append(
+            ("set_device", device, threading.get_ident())
+        )
+
+        def initialize(*args):
+            calls.append(("initialize", args[2], threading.get_ident()))
+            return 0
+
+        engine = object.__new__(MooncakeTransferEngine)
+        engine.gpu_id = 3
+        engine.engine = MagicMock(initialize=initialize)
+
+        with patch.object(platforms, "_current_platform", platform):
+            engine.initialize(hostname="127.0.0.1", device_name="")
+
+        init_thread = calls[-1][2]
+        self.assertNotEqual(init_thread, threading.get_ident())
+        self.assertEqual(
+            calls,
+            [
+                ("set_device", "cuda:3", init_thread),
+                ("initialize", "rdma", init_thread),
+            ],
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
